text.p: Santos Ltd said on Monday that it expected calendar 1996 earnings to exceed last year's result, subject to favourable commodity prices and exchange rates.
"The level of earnings in 1996 is expected to exceed 1995 levels...," the company said in its outlook.
Santos also said it forecast that 1996 production volumes would "moderately exceed" 1995's output.
Sales volumes were expected to be similar to 1995, it added.

The company said earlier on Monday that first half net profit soared to A$88.6 million from A$18.50 million a year ago, citing record production of 18.9 million barrels of oil equivalent as one of the contributing factors.
The company achieved calendar 1995 net profit of A$110.6 million, down from A$190.4 million in 1994. Annual operating profit was A$257.0 million from A$229.6 million.
